companyDescription: Rare metabolic disease · ersodetug (RZ358), an allosteric insulin-receptor antibody for hyperinsulinism — Phase 3 upLIFT in tumor HI MET its primary endpoint on preliminary data (Nov 13: 13 of 16 responders), full topline with statistics by mid-December · ~$100M raised at $3.87 · BLA planned 2027
priceNote: Live $4.00 (-0.37%) on Nov 18, 2026 (live-prices cache) — flat vs the Nov 11 report ($4.02) despite the Nov 13 upLIFT win. The ~$100M offering priced the same day at $3.87 (22.04M shares + 3.8M pre-funded warrants), capping the move. Share count is up ~23%, so the market cap is ~$560M.
summary: Refresh after the catalyst largely fired: on Nov 13, Rezolute said upLIFT (ersodetug in tumor HI) met its primary efficacy endpoint on preliminary Nov 5 data, with 13 of 16 participants responding. Full topline with statistical analysis comes by mid-December. The company raised ~$100M at $3.87 the same day, so the stock sits flat at $4.00 and the share count rose ~23%. The binary has resolved positively, so the remaining upside rests on the full dataset, the FDA pre-BLA path for a single-arm study, and a congenital-HI rescue. Base is cut to $5.80 (+45%) from $7.22 to reflect dilution and a smaller remaining surprise. Cash now covers commercialization prep. phase3_readout has n<5 (context only). แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า FDA ไม่รับข้อมูลแขนเดียว ลงได้ 40–45%.

catalysts.name: upLIFT full topline + statistical analysis (tumor HI)
catalysts.description: Preliminary Nov 5 evaluation: primary efficacy endpoint met, with 13 of 16 participants responding (announced Nov 13). Full topline results, including statistical analysis of the primary endpoint, are guided by mid-December 2026.

catalysts.name: FDA pre-BLA meeting — tumor HI + congenital HI path
catalysts.description: FDA has recommended a pre-BLA meeting before any submission. Rezolute says there is no assurance the existing evidence will support approval, and the congenital-HI label (after the sunRIZE miss) depends on the same discussions.

risks: Single-arm, ~16-patient pivotal: FDA has recommended a pre-BLA meeting, and Rezolute itself says there is no assurance the evidence supports approval.
The win did not re-rate the stock: a ~$100M offering at $3.87 (Nov 13) added ~23% to the share count and absorbed the news.
Credibility discount from the sunRIZE congenital-HI miss (Dec 2025, ~-87%). The market haircuts caveated wins.
Tumor HI (mostly insulinoma/NICTH) is ultra-rare, so peak sales are modest unless the congenital-HI label is rescued.
Macro is WAIT (30/100) with VIX ~23–26; small-cap biotech sells first on a hot Oct PCE (Nov 25).

estimateDates.note: Whether single-arm tumor-HI data can support a BLA

analystTargets.firm: H.C. Wainwright (Oct 2026 — co-manager on Nov 13 offering)

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp. Waller has floated 50bp; Williams pushed back.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset rare-disease biotech. The upLIFT readout dominates. Rates matter only through small-cap biotech risk appetite (XBI/IWM) and the price of a post-data raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — macro is WAIT (30/100): the S&P closed Nov 17 on its 200-day at a 5-month low with VIX ~23–26. The outcome here is idiosyncratic, but small-cap biotech sells first on a hot PCE, so use the dip entry.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2% max — the primary endpoint is in hand and the raise removed the financing overhang, but the big binary is spent. The measured turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($3.50–3.85, around the $3.87 offering price) is preferred.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Small-cap biotechs with a dated pivotal readout often drift higher into the event, but RZLT has slipped ~5% in the past week with the small-cap tape. There is no visible pre-run yet.
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: Flat since Nov 11 (offering at $3.87 absorbed the win)

postWin.note: MDGL rose ~268% in one session on a clean Phase 3 (MAESTRO-NASH, Dec 2022). CAPR ran +300% in two days on HOPE-3 (Dec 2025). Those are top-decile outcomes on large indications; for an ultra-rare, single-arm study a +40-100% re-rating toward the $7-10 target cluster is the realistic base.

postLose.note: RZLT's own sunRIZE miss (Dec 2025) took the stock down ~87%. CMPS fell 36-47% on a Phase 3 that technically hit its endpoint but disappointed on effect size (Jun 2025).

spotSizing.reason: 2% (down from 2.5%). The primary endpoint already printed and the stock didn't re-rate, so the remaining catalyst (full stats, mid-Dec) carries less surprise. phase3_readout has n<5 (context only); lane-wide prior governs (hitRate 6.5%, softHitRate 27.1%).

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). A break below ~$3.0 before the event means the market is pricing a bad outcome.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If upLIFT misses or the responder rate collapses, exit day 1. sunRIZE was ~-87% in Dec 2025, so there is no 'wait for a bounce'.

comparableCases.event: sunRIZE Phase 3 (congenital HI) misses primary endpoint
comparableCases.note: Same drug, same company. This is the downside template if upLIFT disappoints, though tumor HI is a different, smaller single-arm study with a strong interim.

comparableCases.event: MAESTRO-NASH Phase 3 topline hits both endpoints
comparableCases.note: Upper-bound template for a clean pivotal win in a depressed small/mid-cap. MDGL's indication was far larger, so treat it as the Moon-case shape, not the base.

comparableCases.event: COMP005 Phase 3 psilocybin hits primary endpoint but effect size disappoints
comparableCases.note: A technical 'win' can still sell off if the effect looks small. For RZLT, the responder rate versus the 7/8 interim is the number to watch.

th.summary: รีเฟรชหลัง catalyst ส่วนใหญ่ผ่านไปแล้ว: 13 พ.ย. Rezolute ประกาศว่า upLIFT (ersodetug ใน tumor HI) ผ่าน endpoint หลักจากข้อมูลเบื้องต้น 5 พ.ย. ผู้เข้าร่วม 13 จาก 16 รายตอบสนอง ผล topline ฉบับเต็มพร้อมสถิติจะออกภายในกลาง ธ.ค. บริษัทระดมทุน ~$100M ที่ $3.87 ในวันเดียวกัน หุ้นจึงทรงตัวที่ $4.00 และจำนวนหุ้นเพิ่ม ~23% binary จบลงด้านบวกแล้ว upside ที่เหลือขึ้นกับข้อมูลฉบับเต็ม เส้นทาง pre-BLA กับ FDA สำหรับการศึกษาแขนเดียว และการกู้ข้อบ่งใช้ congenital HI ปรับ Base ลงเป็น $5.80 (+45%) จาก $7.22 สะท้อน dilution และ surprise ที่เหลือน้อยลง เงินสดพอเตรียมการเชิงพาณิชย์แล้ว phase3_readout มี n<5 (บริบทเท่านั้น) แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า FDA ไม่รับข้อมูลแขนเดียว ลงได้ 40–45%
th.priceNote: ราคาสด $4.00 (-0.37%) 18 พ.ย. 2026 ทรงตัวจากรายงาน 11 พ.ย. ($4.02) แม้ upLIFT ผ่านเมื่อ 13 พ.ย. การเพิ่มทุน ~$100M ที่ $3.87 วันเดียวกัน (22.04M หุ้น + pre-funded warrant 3.8M) กดการวิ่ง จำนวนหุ้นเพิ่ม ~23% มาร์เก็ตแคป ~$560M
